scenarios.question: Does Hermes restore current direction, queue, blockers, and pending acknowledgement after a supervisor restart?
Does Hermes reduce missed context when a VPS worker reconnects after an offline interval?
Does Hermes reduce owner correction effort across a bounded reasoning-supervisor handoff?

required: no lost or reordered ledger events
at least 20 percent median recovery-time improvement
fewer owner corrections in at least two of three scenarios

providerIndependentScope: Official Hermes SessionDB and built-in memory persistence are exercised without importing production credentials.
